decision.title: Nine Track Mind (Deluxe)
tracklist: We Don't Talk Anymore (feat. Selena Gomez)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (16 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nine_Track_Mind, https://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/NEOIMP-13017. Debut studio album deluxe edition (2016). Used the 16-track digital/international deluxe: 12 standard + See You Again, River, Does It Feel, Nothing But Trouble (Dance Remix). Note: the North American physical deluxe is 15 tracks (omits See You Again) per Wikipedia; the streaming/import deluxe adds See You Again at track 13 per CDJapan and the 2016 digital release. Duplicate entry 'Nine Track Mind (Deluxe) (2016)' is the same edition — recommend merge/delete.
